name: Cloud computing

naics.title: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services

one_line: Rents computing power by the hour, so nobody else has to build a data center.
sells: Computing, storage and AI capacity, rented by usage
customers: Every kind of business, and the AI labs above all
suppliers: AI chips, servers, electricity, land and buildings

revenue.period: 2026 (Synergy: on track to exceed $500B; Q3 2026 alone was $167.7B)

structure.why: Three companies hold about 61% of the market. Fast-growing 'neoclouds' such as CoreWeave rent mostly AI chips.
structure.hhi_note: Top three shares only, so a lower bound.

econ: Economies of scale with high fixed costs: data centers cost billions up front, and each extra customer costs little, so size lowers prices and raises the wall for newcomers.
